root_cause: Legacy SQL advanced a negative outcome to execution, resulting in outcome_pending cycles even though the true sales action was expired or skipped; subsequent corrected logic omitted skipped from blocked branch.

evidence.query: Canonical join decision cycles, sales actions, sales outcomes; status in open/outcome_pending; executed_at NULL, outcome not_executed, revenue=0 and same action_id

prevention_rule: Negative terminal sales action statuses expired and skipped must be blocked, never promoted to execution/outcome_pending. Historical projection correction requires actual source action & outcome pairing and zero paid revenue.
fix: Replace existing SQL function to include skipped in blocked; one bounded guarded status-only reconciliation against existing cycles. No new writer/cron and no event reclassification.
